declaration_order: Published before reading EXEC35 distribution results or applying this rule to any cell
justification: Central 68.27 percent quantile half-width: distribution-free, explicit coverage, independent of a Gaussian shape or histogram tuning
frozen_selection: Use EXEC34C canonical TRAIN even/EVAL odd channels and every N=1..20 unchanged; b uses its existing full-sample channels and existing winning N; c uses its existing TRAIN-selected channels and N. Do not reselect either winner with robust widths.
core_reuse: AST-load unchanged EXEC12T robust function; a scoped numpy proxy maps its [.16,.84] quantile request to [.15865,.84135]. Original imported bytes remain unchanged; the level difference is explicit, not silently treated as identical.
iqr_reuse: AST-load unchanged phase_ab.rsigma function only; never execute that file's top-level campaign or plots

bootstrap.unit: generated event within the fixed partition; resample event IDs with replacement, retain fixed channel IDs/N/calibrations, omit nonfinite timestamps after each resample
bootstrap.error: sample standard deviation of finite bootstrap estimates, ddof=1; also save percentile 2.5/97.5 confidence limits
bootstrap.pairing: Reset the same stream for each same-length partition/distribution/cell, aligning event-index bootstrap draws; do not claim independent cells
bootstrap.gaussian_TOP: Reuse the existing EXEC34C Gaussian point and its recorded 300-replicate, seed-20260618 bootstrap error; do not refit or alter it. Accepted-fit fraction was not archived and is unverified.
bootstrap.gaussian_END: Keep existing FitCore and FitPeakSeeded points; bootstrap their unchanged primitives with the 500 event resamples to obtain Gaussian comparison errors

histogram.bins: ceil(sqrt(n_finite)) equal-width bins over observed min..max, fixed for bootstrap
histogram.crossing: first outward crossing of half the maximum on each side of that peak, linear interpolation between bin centers; zero-count ghost bin one bin-width beyond either boundary
histogram.interpretation: Contiguous peak-local FWHM; no smoothing, adaptive retry or tuning; ghosts are a declared boundary convention, not measured density beyond support

validity.gaussian: VALID only if fit_status=0 (END FitCore usedFit true; Peak success branch positive), 0<=chi2/ndf<=2, n_eff>=200, efficiency>=0.05, finite positive width and bootstrap SE with SE/width<=0.25. For new END bootstraps at least 95 percent estimates must be successful finite fits. Existing TOP accepted-bootstrap fraction is unverified, never fabricated. Failures are recorded by reason; no refit.
validity.robust_primary: VALID independently of Gaussian verdict if provenance/frozen selection verified, n_eff>=200, efficiency>=0.05, finite strictly positive sigma_core, at least 95 percent finite bootstrap estimates, and finite positive bootstrap SE with SE/sigma_core<=0.25. Gaussian model adequacy is not a prerequisite for a nonparametric width.
validity.cell_bias: Include a cell in primary b-c only if both frozen b and c robust-primary widths are VALID; retain all 21 rows, marking exclusions. Histogram/IQR failures do not veto a valid primary.
validity.END_gaussian_compatibility: Call END consistent with these Gaussian diagnostics only if its Gaussian validity passes, central asymmetry is within 3 bootstrap SE of zero, and sigma_core versus existing sigma_gauss agrees within 3 quadrature bootstrap SE. This is a limited descriptive diagnostic, not proof of normality; same-event covariance is not estimated.

bias_sign_test: Two-sided exact binomtest(n_positive,n_nonzero,p=0.5); exclude exact ties and invalid robust b/c. Report as nominal iid-sign p-value only: shared-seed paired cells are correlated, so it is not a calibrated significance for this grid.
